'''Josh Wittenin''' (also published as '''Josh Wittenen''' and '''Josh Wiitanen''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[April 2000 St. Cloud tournament]] on 15 April 2000, according to Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d550">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-st-cloud-mn-java-z-4-15-00d550/ st-cloud-mn-java-z-4-15-00], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-st-cloud-mn-java-z-4-15-00d550/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He won the [[February 2001 St. Cloud tournament]] on 24 February 2001, according to Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1798">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-jeeps-st-cloud-report-2-24-01d1798/ jeeps-st-cloud-report-2-24-01], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 26 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-jeeps-st-cloud-report-2-24-01d1798/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
